typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		MetricDate as string,
		Aging as integer,
		Next_Action_Date as date,
		Case_ID as string,
		Nostro as string,
		CCY as string,
		CCY_Amount as string,
		USD_Equiv_Amt as string,
		Value_date as string,
		Side as string,
		{D C} as string,
		Case_type as string,
		Case_Sub_Type as string,
		Case_Status as string,
		INVESTIGATOR as string,
		User_Update_Date_Time as string,
		Tran_Ref as string,
		Incoming_TRN as string,
		CMR_ID as string,
		Customer_Legal_Name as string,
		Covering_Employee_Name as string,
		Dept as string,
		DF1073 as string,
		RTMBInd as string,
		CaseCreationDate as string,
		GSMOSSTATUS as string,
		SWIFTSTATUS as string,
		DIRECTION as string,
		FIELD20_2 as string,
		Desc2 as string,
		Item_ID as string,
		Source_Reference as string,
		MT as string,
		Customer_Name as string,
		Description as string,
		midasDealNumber as string,
		Deal_Number as string,
		Deal_Source as string,
		Source as string,
		Unique_ID_MP as string,
		rate as string,
		Desc1 as string,
		Bank_Ref as string,
		Beneficiary as string,
		Line_86_Stmt_Text as string,
		OpsControlDesc as string,
		Notes as string,
		PgDesignation as string,
		ReportDate as string,
		Aging_Bucket as string,
		Aging_Bucket_order as string,
		ThirdPartyCCYInd as string,
		OSI as string,
		UNASSIGNED_FLAG as string,
		UNASSIGNED_DAY2_FLAG as string,
		UN_ACTIONED as string,
		UN_ACTIONED_DAY2_FLAG as string,
		Failure_to_Receive as integer,
		L1_amberThreshold as string,
		L1_redThreshold as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of MetricDate} = MetricDate) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		LoadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Case_Status as string,
		Customer_Name as string,
		CCY_Amount as string,
		D_C as string,
		Next_Action_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Line_86_Stmt_Text as string,
		Aging as integer,
		Covering_Employee_Name as string,
		Aging_Bucket_order as string,
		UN_ACTIONED as string,
		Bank_Ref as string,
		Case_ID as string,
		Aging_Bucket as string,
		Case_Sub_Type as string,
		MT as string,
		CMR_ID as string,
		OpsControlDesc as string,
		Deal_Number as string,
		UNASSIGNED_FLAG as string,
		INVESTIGATOR as string,
		SWIFTSTATUS as string,
		Source_Reference as string,
		Case_type as string,
		midasDealNumber as string,
		PgDesignation as string,
		Description as string,
		UN_ACTIONED_DAY2_FLAG as string,
		Customer_Legal_Name as string,
		Dept as string,
		Deal_Source as string,
		ThirdPartyCCYInd as string,
		DF1073 as string,
		Value_date as string,
		ReportDate as string,
		FIELD20_2 as string,
		Incoming_TRN as string,
		Desc2 as string,
		Desc1 as string,
		Source as string,
		User_Update_Date_Time as string,
		Side as string,
		Nostro as string,
		rate as string,
		Tran_Ref as string,
		Notes as string,
		GSMOSSTATUS as string,
		OSI as string,
		USD_Equiv_Amt as string,
		DIRECTION as string,
		Unique_ID_MP as string,
		CaseCreationDate as string,
		CCY as string,
		RTMBInd as string,
		Failure_to_Receive as integer,
		MetricDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Item_ID as string,
		Beneficiary as string,
		UNASSIGNED_DAY2_FLAG as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		Case_Status,
		Customer_Name,
		CCY_Amount,
		D_C = {D C},
		Next_Action_Date,
		Line_86_Stmt_Text,
		Aging,
		Covering_Employee_Name,
		Aging_Bucket_order,
		UN_ACTIONED,
		Bank_Ref,
		Case_ID,
		Aging_Bucket,
		Case_Sub_Type,
		MT,
		CMR_ID,
		OpsControlDesc,
		Deal_Number,
		UNASSIGNED_FLAG,
		INVESTIGATOR,
		SWIFTSTATUS,
		Source_Reference,
		Case_type,
		midasDealNumber,
		PgDesignation,
		Description,
		UN_ACTIONED_DAY2_FLAG,
		Customer_Legal_Name,
		Dept,
		Deal_Source,
		ThirdPartyCCYInd,
		DF1073,
		Value_date,
		ReportDate,
		FIELD20_2,
		Incoming_TRN,
		Desc2,
		Desc1,
		Source,
		User_Update_Date_Time,
		Side,
		Nostro,
		rate,
		Tran_Ref,
		Notes,
		GSMOSSTATUS,
		OSI,
		USD_Equiv_Amt,
		DIRECTION,
		Unique_ID_MP,
		CaseCreationDate,
		CCY,
		RTMBInd,
		Failure_to_Receive,
		MetricDate = {Copy of MetricDate},
		Item_ID,
		Beneficiary,
		UNASSIGNED_DAY2_FLAG),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
